variation.name: bir51_tc_baseline
variation.description: A minimal but fully valid BIR51 tax computation. All mandatory items are present and correctly tagged. Every optional flag is false or omitted. Currency is HKD. Standard 12-month basis period ending 31 March 2026. No business commencement, cessation, offshore claim, or special regimes. Intended as the clean passing baseline and starting point for derived scenarios.
